dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First BORME date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the latest publication day.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last BORME date (YYYY-MM-DD). Max 31 days per run.

provinces.title: Provinces
provinces.description: Province names or INE codes (e.g. Madrid, 29, Valencia). Empty = all of Spain.

mode.title: What to extract
enumTitles: Corporate events only (moves, capital, dissolutions, insolvency)

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Keep only incorporations in these sectors. Empty = all.

keywords.title: Keywords in corporate purpose
keywords.description: Keep only records whose name or corporate purpose contains any of these words.
